message: I want to buy your listed coffee table right away. Since I am out of town, please accept payment via wire transfer and send $100 to my courier service via Zelle at logistics.example to arrange pickup.
Hi, is the vintage bicycle still available for sale? I am really interested in buying it for my brother, but I prefer discussing the pickup details over email at buyer@example.
My dear friend, my uncle trade supervisor guaranteed a 400% profit on crypto trades today. Please deposit $500 into your account at global-funds.example right now so we can trade together.
I have been reading a lot about cryptocurrency market trends lately and learning how decentralized finance works. Do you ever follow digital asset markets or trade online?
Hello beautiful, I found your phone number in my contact list and felt drawn to message you. Send me $50 gift card so I can buy gas and come visit you tonight.
Good morning! Is this Sarah from the community garden project? Sorry if I got the wrong number, my phone restored old contacts unexpectedly.

Congratulations! You were selected for our remote product reviewer position. To unlock your daily commission tasks, transfer a refundable $200 security deposit to account portal at task-admin.example.
We saw your interest in flexible work-from-home opportunities evaluating online storefronts. Reply YES if you would like more details about our daily rating assignment program.

Hi there, I noticed your professional background on LinkedIn and thought your skills might fit a senior project coordinator role we have open. Are you open to discussing potential career moves?

We have built such a wonderful connection over these weeks. If you trust me, transfer $1,000 to the arbitrage platform options-wealth.example today and I will manage your portfolio personally.
